sample_size_rule: Fixed counts: 50 primary pairs, one pair per alternative age schedule and historical replay using seed 2014, and two long-follow-up pairs.
modifier_interpretation: One catchall annual probability max(base tenure/nationality/category rate, conditional age-retention hazard) in all five EB categories; no independent mortality draw or legacy age floor.
uncertainty_scope: Student-t intervals describe numerical uncertainty in fixed-input simulation means. Age schedules and historical replay are separate sensitivity experiments, not probability bounds.
sensitivity_budget_rationale: Fifty paired replications support primary means and subgroup summaries. Age-schedule comparisons and historical replay use seed 2014, consistent with the parameter sensitivities. The two long-follow-up pairs remain a separate diagnostic.
